name: LabSound/LabSound
description: Graph-based C++ audio engine derived from WebKit's WebAudio implementation, providing a node-based DSP graph for games, visualizers, live coding environments, and audio applications.
score_rationale: Unique graph-based audio engine with 782 stars and BSD-2-Clause license, offering a Web Audio-style API for C++ projects, though development stalled in 2023.
summary: Graph-based audio engine with Web Audio-style API
